steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japan SLPS-02074 CUE/BIN, 291095280 bytes, with SHA-1 d33f5e7f73a5a4d0c92f157c2106fe53c789358c. Your original files remain yours; Portcove has not downloaded or run the game files or player for this guide.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s run.bat instructions to import your own data, download pinned build tools and compile out/Asuka120_Recompiled.exe. OpenBIOS is supplied. Complete this source setup with the project’s tools; Portcove does not install or confirm the resulting player.
